message: The streaming request of POST /chat (named by its x-fern-request-name) is named "Talk", which is already declared by the non-streaming request of POST /chat (named by its x-fern-request-name) at #/paths/~1chat/post/x-fern-request-name. fern check fails with "Talk is already declared". Fern splits an operation with an x-fern-streaming stream-condition into a streaming and a non-streaming endpoint, each with its own request. Name the two requests with x-fern-request-name on the operation and stream-request-name in x-fern-streaming.
